description: Forgejo Actions runner lane policy for the EdgeVector local forge. Since 2026-09-30 only the `lastgit` repo stays on Forgejo; every other EdgeVector repo is on GitHub. Only the merge-gate lane is live. The heavy lane is retired: its repo-scoped runners served fold and exemem-infra, both on GitHub now. The gaming PC runners (pc-forge-runner, pc-heavy-runner) were retired on 2026-09-29. Merge-blocking ci-required runs on the macos-arm64 host lane.

merge_gate.purpose: Pre-merge ci-required only, for the lastgit repo (the one repo left on Forgejo).
merge_gate.notes: Mac merge runner is host-only macos-arm64 (docker label dropped 2026-07-13). No docker lane exists: the PC pc-forge-runner that served docker/* was retired 2026-09-29. Do not attach long release/deploy workflows to these labels.

heavy.purpose: RETIRED 2026-09-30. Long-running non-gating work on Mac host runners for fold tags and exemem-infra deploys. Both repos are on GitHub now (GitHub Actions), so no Forgejo heavy runner is expected. Re-adding a heavy lane is a deliberate decision. Never a required pre-merge status.

workflow_routing.example: release.yml / deploy jobs: runs-on: macos (Mac host). Leave ci-required needs: limited to merge-gate jobs only.

heavy.notes: pc-heavy-runner (PC docker, label heavy) was retired 2026-09-29. The Mac host runners for fold and exemem-infra (com.edgevector.forgejo-runner-host, -host-exemem-infra) are not expected or watched any more; Tom may leave them loaded or bootout them.

proof.expected: Local discovery only. The heavy lane is retired (heavy.retired), so heavy_ok is true without a heavy runner; the check fails only when a merge-gate home advertises the heavy label or a merge-gate runner is offline.
